category5.design: The stock fuzz_eval imports the std and os modules into globalThis, so a JavaScript PoV could read /proc/self/exe or run commands and print per build; the driver is fuzz_eval/fuzz_common adapted without std/os, without a module loader and without __loadScript (limits, interrupt handler, console.log and print kept), linked with the build's libquickjs.fuzz.a. Output-diff on exit status and output.
